title: SAAM Machine-Resolved Process Plan
description: A versioned, machine-resolved plan: motion, tool/process state, operation dependencies, provenance, validation results, revision, and approval state. Independent of controller syntax and of any specific interface; not independent of the machine it was resolved against.

revision.description: Increments on any change to part, machine, settings, or operations. An approval record is bound to one exact revision by content hash; any of those changes invalidates it.

part.description: Extensible part-level envelope. Additional shape-specific fields are permitted; `shape` names which fields apply.

id.description: Machine definition id this plan is resolved against (see machines/).

profileRevision.description: Version or revision of the machine's instance profile used to resolve this plan.

machine.description: A process plan is meaningless without this. Re-resolving for a different machine is a new plan, not a portable one.

invocationId.description: Unique within this plan. Stable across revisions of the same logical operation instance so dependency and approval history can track it.

operationId.description: References an operation manifest's `id` (schemas/manifests/). Not a display name.

operationVersion.description: The operation's own version (manifest `version`) that produced this invocation's output.

parameters.description: Must validate against the referenced operation's manifest `inputs` schema.

dependencies.description: invocationIds of other operations in this plan that must be resolved first.

generatedBy.description: operationId@operationVersion of the generator that produced this invocation's paths.

inputHash.description: Hash of parameters + settings + machine profile, for reproducibility checks.

status.description: preview-only: viewable, not yet post-processed. approved: has a current, matching approval record. superseded: a later revision exists; this one is kept for history.

revision.description: Must equal this document's own `revision`. An approval whose revision doesn't match the current plan is void.

scope.description: Geometry approval, export authorization, and direct machine-control authorization are separate permissions; this records which one was granted.

approval.description: null until an explicit human interface action creates it. Never created by an adapter or by chat text alone.
